EmailTemplate.description: BT HRS only - Send to client to request a welcome call meeting
EmailTemplate.name: BT-HRS-New Client Welcome Call
EmailTemplate.subject: New Client Welcome Call Request
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Good morning/afternoon Client,
I hope you are well. I’d like to introduce myself as your HR specialist and client liaison. I work as your strategic partner to understand your unique business needs and goals so that I can make recommendations to best maximize Insperity’s services.
I’d like to schedule a call to discuss the Insperity partnership, your company’s goals and objectives, and begin to build a plan in which we can best assist you in achieving those goals. Please let me know what time works best for you, and I will send a calendar invite.
I have attached your Service Team contact sheet so you can identify the various Insperity team members that support you as well you, as well as their role descriptions.
I also encourage you to review the Guide to Insperity for Onsite Supervisors. It is a helpful resource that provides insight into various Insperity procedures, responsibilities, and information that helps as you begin to navigate the Insperity relationship. Please let me know if you would like a hard copy and I will be happy to have them shipped to you.
I look forward to working with you.
Please let me know if you have any questions.
